title: THE GRAND LUGGAGE HUSHIFIER

engineering.annoyance: Hard suitcase wheels chatter loudly while being dragged across tiled public floors.
engineering.current_workaround: Carry the suitcase, endure the racket, or choose alternative luggage with no guaranteed noise result.
engineering.object_form: Small carry-on suitcase with interchangeable soft-tread wheel cartridges and floating mounts.
engineering.operating_principle: Softer contact materials can mitigate hard-surface chatter; compliant mounts can isolate vibration transmitted into the case body.
engineering.mechanism_assumptions: Noise will depend on wheel material, speed, suitcase load, floor surface, weather, wheel wear and implementation. No testing has occurred.
engineering.tradeoff: Soft wheel treads may wear faster and isolation adds weight, replacement parts and mechanical complexity.
engineering.novelty_note: For illustrative calibration only. Existing soft luggage wheels and damping approaches may overlap; no prior-art review has been conducted.

slide_1.title: THE GRAND LUGGAGE HUSHIFIER
slide_1.hook: I refuse to let another airport hear the entire contents of my suitcase.

slide_2.heading: A CATASTROPHE ON WHEELS
slide_2.body: For years I have endured the dreadful racket of luggage crossing a tiled floor. We can carry a passenger across an ocean in a pressurized aluminum tube, yet the final fifty yards sound like an overturned cutlery drawer. An embarrassment to civilization.

slide_3.mechanical_thesis: Replace clatter with a carefully engineered glide, and make the wheel assembly repairable.

features.title: VELVET-FOOTED ROLLERS
features.explanation: Replaceable soft treads aim to reduce the hard clatter of plastic wheels on tile.

features.title: THE FLOATING AXLE
features.explanation: Compliant mounts interrupt some of the vibration that would otherwise rattle through the case.

features.title: THE GREAT BEARING SEAL
features.explanation: Protected wheel bearings help keep grit away from an entirely unnecessary percussion section.

slide_4.question: Would you install my Hushifier, or have we all simply agreed to drag our dignity behind us?

caption:
I have spent an unreasonable amount of time listening to suitcase wheels commit crimes against polished airport floors. My proposed cure: softer treads, floating wheel mounts, and a little less public embarrassment.

Would you give this a spin, or return me to my laboratory? Fictional concept, not a product for sale.
